sections.content:
Levellr is the enterprise marketing solution for Discord, used by some of the world’s largest gaming companies (Scopely, Krafton, Epic), brands (Google Gemini & YouTube) and music labels (Universal, Warner) to help them grow, manage and monetise communities on Discord.
We’re currently building a curated pool of experienced Discord moderators for future, ongoing opportunities.
This is not a role tied to an immediate opening — instead, successful applicants will be added to our moderator network and contacted when projects arise that match their experience and availability.

sections.heading: What you'd do:
sections.content:
Keep communities safe by monitoring for harmful content, enforcing rules, and handling escalations
Work behind the scenes and/or actively engage with community members, depending on the project
Follow our structured moderation framework with clear guidelines and escalation paths
Follow clear client-specific tone and communication flow
Actively participate in community conversations, bringing genuine knowledge of the subject matter
Provide constructive feedback based on the community and your experience

sections.heading: What we're looking for:
sections.content:
Proven Discord moderation experience (personal servers count!), or moderation experience on other chat platforms
Strong safety instincts — you can spot phishing, harassment, and rule violations quickly
Trustworthy and consistent — you handle confidential information with discretion, moderate impartially, and communicate proactively with your team
Comfortable building rapport with community members while maintaining a clear professional boundary
Bonus:
genuine interest in music, gaming, or tech communities
comfortable with moderation bots and tooling (AutoMod, custom bots)

sections.heading: What we offer:
sections.content:
Professional training and onboarding
A supportive internal moderator community
Flexible hours and remote work across time zones
This is a paid freelance, remote position. We're interested in candidates from all time zones.

To express interest, please fill out this form, and we will be in touch should your application be successful.
